title: Kanak Srivastava v. State of U.P. and others
coram: Shekhar B. Saraf, J.; Dr. Yogendra Kumar Srivastava, J.
disposition: Clause 6.5 order quashed; remanded for fresh hearing.
headnote: An order under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, passed without hearing the consumer is liable to be quashed. On the licensee's concession, the High Court set aside the Executive Engineer's order and directed the consumer to appear on a fixed date so that a fresh order could be passed after opportunity of hearing and consideration of the material produced. Prayers to quash the bills and for meter correction or a new supply were not decided on merits.
facts: Kanak Srivastava challenged the Executive Engineer, Purvanchal Vidyut Vitran Nigam Limited's order dated 25.03.2025 under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, together with electricity bills, and sought correction of dues and the meter plus a new meter and supply in her name. She alleged the Clause 6.5 order, though passed pursuant to an earlier High Court direction, was made without hearing. The Power Corporation agreed to fix a date and pass a fresh order after due opportunity.

holding_units.holding: An order under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, passed without affording the consumer opportunity of hearing is liable to be quashed; the consumer shall appear before the Executive Engineer on a fixed date and a fresh order shall be passed after hearing and considering the material produced.

not_decided.point: validity of the impugned electricity bills and correction of dues and meter
not_decided.note: Certiorari against the bills and mandamus to correct dues and the meter were not decided; the dispute was remitted for a fresh Clause 6.5 order.

not_decided.point: new electricity supply and meter in the petitioner's name
not_decided.note: Mandamus for essential supply and installation of a new meter was neither granted nor refused on merits.
